theater: 涇原路定川寨（寧夏彭陽）

battle.name: 定川寨之戰
battle.theater: 涇原路定川寨（寧夏彭陽）
battle.brief: 慶曆二年春，西夏元昊分兵深入涇原路，圍攻定川寨。守將劉平、張亢以數千步騎拒守，援軍范仲淹為夏軍所阻，寨破而劉平歿於城中。此役係宋夏戰爭中宋廷又一次大敗，直接催生范仲淹答手詔條陳十事與慶曆和議。卡面所配拜占庭希臘火從未東傳，交鋒靠的仍是神臂弓、拒馬與火矢。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 此役交戰的兩方是北宋與西夏。北宋方面，自康定元年起陝西分永興軍路、秦鳳路、鄜延路、涇原路四路，環慶軍為東線重鎮，渭州（治平涼）是西線的節制所在；陝西經略安撫使（宣撫使）總攝軍務，慶曆二年二月由韓琦接任，前任夏竦去職，副使范仲淹知鄴州、襄贊軍務。定川寨屬涇原路，是沿邊屯兵堡寨之一，寨兵以步卒為主，輔以蕃兵、邊民弓箭手與臨時募得的騎兵；宋廷西北缺馬，全線只能靠弩弓、拒馬、堡寨與屯田立腳，軍糧由秦鳳、熙河的屯田和關中車隊遠程轉運，一旦前線被切斷，援兵與糧秣都要以旬月計。西夏方面，元昊自領中樞並統兵出塞，漢臣張儼、野利仁榮掌尚書與出使文書，涼州、靈州一帶的牧場出馬，兵陣以步兵前列、鐵鷂子精騎居中衝鋒、輕騎兩翼包抄，另以羌、吐蕃部眾充軍，糧秣靠涼州屯墾、河套墾牧與戰地掠奪。背景是宋夏自一〇三八年開戰後的邊境態勢：三川口、好水川兩役宋軍皆敗，宋以澶淵之盟牽制契丹，夏則周旋於宋、遼之間，這一役正是兩個政權在實力尚未均衡時的試探與消耗。
countriesEn: The two parties in this battle were the Northern Song and Western Xia. On the Song side, from the first year of Kangding Shaanxi was divided into four circuits — Yongxingjun, Qinfeng, Fuyan and Jingyuan — the Huanqing army being the strongpoint on the eastern line, while Weizhou, whose seat was Pingliang, was the command point of the western line; the commissioner for the pacification and defence of Shaanxi (the xuanfu commissioner) held the general conduct of military affairs, and in the second month of the second year of Qingli Han Qi took over that post, the former commissioner Xia Song having been removed, with Fan Zhongyan as deputy commissioner governing Yanzhou and assisting in military planning. Dingchuanzhai belonged to the Jingyuan circuit; it was one of the garrisoned border forts, and the men in it were mainly infantry, supported by Tibetan auxiliaries, bowmen drawn from the border population and hastily recruited horse. The Song lacked horses in the north-west, so the whole line could stand on nothing but crossbows, caltrops, forts and garrison farms, and the grain came from the farms of Qinfeng and Xihe and from waggon convoys out of Guanzhong; once the forward line was cut, reinforcements and rations were counted in tens of days. On the Xia side, Yuanhao himself held the centre and led his troops out of the country, with Han officials such as Zhang Yan and Ye Li Renrong handling the ministry and the diplomatic correspondence; the horses came from the pastures around Liangzhou and Lingzhou, the order of battle put infantry in front, the armoured iron-vult horse in the centre to charge and light horse on both wings to envelop, and Qiang and Tibetan were enrolled to fill the ranks, while food and fodder came from the settlements of Liangzhou, the farming and herding of Hetao, and foraging on the spot. The background was the state of the border since the war began in 1038: the Song had been defeated at Sanchuankou and at Haoshuichuan, the Song held the Khitan in check under the Chanyuan treaty, and Xia moved between Song and Liao, so this engagement was one of those probes and attritional tests that two polities fought while their strength was still unequal.
people: 主動進攻的是西夏主元昊。他分兵兩路：一部專攻定川寨，一部截斷宋方由鄴州西行的援軍，兩個目標同時進行，這是此役的關鍵安排。宋方守寨主將是劉平，據《宋史·劉平傳》，他與張亢奉命守定川寨，劉平時任涇原副都部署；寨破時他中矢，力竭而死，朝廷聞訊追贈恤典。與劉平同守的張亢突圍而還，事後遭御史論以逗留之罪，一度為眾所非；范仲淹上書力言其功，張亢才得洗清。援軍的主帥是范仲淹，他自鄴州率兵西行，途中為夏軍別部所阻，進退失據，待寨已陷，只得引軍而還，事後廷議有譏其逗留者，韓琦則上書為他辯護，說明前線指揮一度真空、援軍難以及時。新到任的陝西四路宣撫使韓琦在二月至涇原後，力主放棄野戰、專守堡寨，把西線軍務收束到渭州、環慶一線的城寨體系上。前任宣撫使夏竦持主戰之論，與范仲淹在和戰與用兵之法上屢有爭執，這場敗仗之後更成眾矢之的；范仲淹同年十一月獻答手詔條陳十事，主張冊封元昊、議和劃界，次年更被貶知睦州，直到慶曆四年和議既定才回朝任職。
peopleEn: The man who chose to attack was Yuanhao, the ruler of Western Xia. He split his force in two: one part was to sit down before Dingchuanzhai, the other to cut the road by which Song relief would march from Yanzhou, and the two objects were pursued at once — that was the key of the battle. The Song commander in the fort was Liu Ping; according to the biography of Liu Ping in the History of Song, he and Zhang Kang were ordered to hold Dingchuanzhai, Liu Ping then holding the post of deputy commander of the Jingyuan circuit. When the fort fell he was struck by an arrow, fought out his strength and died, and the court heard of it and granted him posthumous honours and a pension. Zhang Kang, who had shared the defence, broke out of the fort and came back, and afterwards the censors charged him with having lingered and shirked, so that for a time he was generally condemned; Fan Zhongyan wrote to court insisting on his merit, and only then was Zhang Kang cleared. The commander of the relief force was Fan Zhongyan. He marched west from Yanzhou and was checked on the way by a detached Xia force, caught between advance and retreat, and by the time he learned that the fort had already fallen he could only lead his men back; afterwards the court debated whether he had lingered, and Han Qi wrote in his defence, pointing out that the command on the forward line had been vacant for a time and that relief could not arrive in time. Han Qi, the newly appointed xuanfu commissioner of the four circuits of Shaanxi, reached Jingyuan in the second month and pressed for the abandonment of pitched battle in favour of the forts, drawing the western line's military effort back into the system of strongholds around Weizhou and Huanqing. His predecessor Xia Song held the line of war rather than negotiation, and had already clashed with Fan Zhongyan over peace or war and over how the war should be fought; after this defeat he became a target for all, and Fan Zhongyan in the eleventh month of the same year presented his Reply to the Imperial Edict with Ten Articles, urging that Yuanhao be invested as Prince of Xia, that silk and silver be paid yearly, that a boundary be drawn and the border markets reopened — and the following year he was demoted to govern Mutzhou, returning to office only after the settlement of 1044 had been made.
kits: 卡面這件希臘火屬於拜占庭帝國，約六七〇年前後配在青銅管中噴射，是稠厚難以點熄的燃燒劑，帝國把配方列為最高機密，傳說配方隨沉船一同失落，此後再沒有第二套辦法。它的戰術任務只有一個：用火封住正在移動的對手，點燃敵船的燃料，使進攻方失去動力而不能靠岸；管口有限、射程有限，它從來不是野戰的投射兵器，而是船首與城牆上的近距離阻斷工具。卡面沒有出現在定川寨，原因很直接：這套裝備與配方從未離開拜占庭，中亞與宋境沒有任何一條線索顯示它東來。此役雙方真正上手的是弩與火。宋軍的骨幹是神臂弓、蹶張弓與床子弩，弓臂長、矢重，號稱能洞穿夏軍重甲，床子弩架在車上可以連發；步卒結陣持長槍大刀，寨外以橐車、拒馬槊與陷馬障遲滯騎兵，軍中備有火矢與火箭，用以燒灼暴露在牆外的攻兵。攻城一方則用雲梯、撞竿與火把草束：撞竿撞寨門，雲梯貼牆，同時放火燒寨內草屋，以煙火掩護登城。西夏最重的是鐵鷂子，人馬皆披重甲，只等寨牆出現缺口才衝入；步卒與羌兵負責填壕、架梯、拔拒馬。當時兩軍都沒有能改變攻城器械運作的火藥兵器：宋軍火藥武器仍停留在投擲的火箭與火球階段，《武經總要》成書於慶曆四年，書中已有砲與火藥箭的圖樣，但定川寨之役並無火藥上陣的記載。希臘火與火矢的分別不在火本身，而在那支銅管：一支能連續噴出黏稠火焰並隨時熄滅，一支只能射出一支燒著的箭。
kitsEn: The Greek fire on this card belongs to the Byzantine Empire. From about 670 it was projected from bronze tubes, and it was a thick burning fluid that was hard to put out; the empire kept the formula as its highest secret, and the story is that it was lost with a ship that sank, so that no second way of producing it was ever found. Its tactical task was a single one: to use fire to stop a target that was moving, to set alight the fuel of an enemy ship and rob the attacker of the motive power he needed to come alongside. Because the bore was small and the reach short, it was never a field weapon but a close-range blocking tool mounted on ship bows and on city walls. It did not appear at Dingchuanzhai for a plain reason: neither the equipment nor the formula ever left Byzantium, and no thread of evidence connects them with Central Asia or with Song territory. What the two sides actually handled here were the crossbow and fire. The backbone of the Song army was the divine-arm bow, the treading bow and the bed crossbow: the bow arms were long, the shafts heavy, and they were said to pierce the heavy armour of the Xia, while the bed crossbow was set up on a waggon and could fire in sequence; the infantry closed up with long spears and broadswords, waggons, caltrop spears and horse-traps were ranged outside the fort to hold the horse back, and the army carried fire-arrows and incendiary shafts to burn the attackers exposed on the wall. The besiegers used scaling ladders, battering rams and bundles of torches with straw: the rams struck the gate of the stockade, the ladders were laid against the wall, and at the same time fires were set to the straw buildings inside so that smoke and flame would cover the escalade. The heaviest Xia arm was the iron-vult horse, man and beast both armoured, held in reserve until a breach appeared in the wall; infantry and Qiang troops filled the ditch, set up the ladders and pulled out the caltrops. Neither army possessed a gunpowder weapon that could alter the working of siege machinery: Song gunpowder weapons were still confined to thrown fire-arrows and fire-balls, and although the Military Manual, completed in the fourth year of Qingli, already carried diagrams of the trebuchet and of gunpowder arrows, no gunpowder is recorded as having been used in the fighting at Dingchuanzhai. The difference between Greek fire and a fire-arrow is not the fire itself but the tube: one spits a stream of burning fluid that can be put out at will, the other shoots a single shaft that is alight.
tactics: 夏軍的打法是典型的圍點打援。一部以撞竿撞寨門、雲梯貼牆、步卒填壕拔拒馬，同時點燃寨內草屋製造煙火；另一部在宋軍由鄴州西行的道路上布阻，使援軍與守軍不能互相接應。寨牆上的宋軍把主力放在缺口與登城點，居高以神臂弓、床子弩壓制貼牆的雲梯，箭幕之外以火矢射擊暴露在牆外的攻兵，步卒在寨門與牆頭缺口處結成長槍大刀之陣，缺口前再以拒馬與叉竿橫阻登城者，寨內備有沙袋與水缸以備火攻。整個圍城歷時數十日，攻守雙方都在算糧：夏軍就地掠奪，可以久圍，宋軍援兵與糧秣卻要自關中遠運，遲一日便弱一分。援軍方面，范仲淹自鄴州出兵，行至途中受阻，既不能與寨中守軍合兵，也不敢貿然深入，最終引還；此役之後宋廷不再以野戰求勝，韓琦到任即收束兵線，把重點放在城寨、弓弩與屯田。西線地形也起了作用：涇原路在黃土高原與河谷之間，二月天寒地凍，溪澗可涉而道路泥濘，大隊步騎與車隊的行動被地勢與天氣拖慢，這是宋軍援兵遲滯的另一層原因。
tacticsEn: The Xia method was the classic combination of besieging a point and cutting its relief. One part of the army struck the gate of the stockade with battering rams, laid ladders against the wall, filled the ditch with infantry and pulled out the caltrops, and at the same time burned the straw buildings inside so that smoke and flame covered the business; the other part was posted on the road by which the Song marched west from Yanzhou, so that the relief and the besieged could never join hands. The Song on the wall put the bulk of their strength on the breaches and the points of escalade, shooting down the ladders with the divine-arm bow and the bed crossbow from above, laying a curtain of arrows over the wall, and beyond that curtain using fire-arrows against the attackers caught in the open; the infantry held the gate and the breaches with a wall of long spears and broadswords, and in front of the breach they laid the caltrops and forked poles to bar the escalade, with sandbags and water jars kept inside against the fire. The siege lasted some tens of days, and both sides were counting grain: the Xia could maintain a long investment on what they took from the countryside, whereas Song reinforcements and rations had to be hauled the whole way from Guanzhong, and every day lost made the garrison weaker. On the relief column, Fan Zhongyan marched out from Yanzhou, was checked on the road, could neither join the garrison nor risk a deep advance, and finally turned back; after this battle the court no longer looked for victory in the open field, and Han Qi on his arrival contracted the line and put the weight on forts, crossbows and garrison farms. The ground itself told in the matter: the Jingyuan circuit lay between the loess plateau and the river valleys, and in the second month the cold was hard, the streams passable but the roads mud, so the movement of large bodies of foot and horse and of the baggage waggons was slowed by the country and the season — that was the other reason why the Song relief arrived late.
data: 留下數字的只有《宋史·劉平傳》《宋史·夏國傳》等零星記載。兵力方面，宋人記元昊「率眾十萬」來寇，這是宋人對西夏大軍的慣用概數，實際到陣的步騎當在數萬之數，作戰骨幹是鐵鷂子精騎；守寨的宋軍據記載只有數千人，由劉平與張亢合領步騎，寨外援軍由范仲淹率領，數量遠多於守軍，韓琦抵渭州時所部號稱十萬，但那是全線合計的概數，並非全部壓向定川寨。圍攻歷時數十日，寨破的時間在慶曆二年二月前後；宋人記載劉平歿於寨中，張亢突圍而還，器械、糧秣與寨中儲備盡陷，兩軍確切死傷與繳獲數字均無可考，不宜編造。距離上，定川寨距渭州治所約百餘里，至原州約二百餘里，宋軍援軍自鄴州西行，行程以百里計，這就是「援軍難以及時」的地理尺度。城寨方面，定川寨原本只是寨而不是築有完整城垣的城，寨破之後宋廷在原址重新築城，地理志記為慶曆年間所築，沿邊各路堡寨在慶曆以後於《宋史·地理志》中成串增列。背景數字可與和議對照：慶曆四年和議，記宋每年賜西夏銀二萬五千兩、絹十三萬匹、茶二萬斤，折絹二十五萬五千匹，並置榷場於保安軍、鎮戎軍，後增太原府。卡面那件兵器則更早，約六七〇年前後見於君士坦丁堡之圍，此後配方失傳，此戰與它無涉。
dataEn: The only figures that survive are the scattered notices in the biography of Liu Ping and in the account of the Xia state in the History of Song. On strength, the Song records say Yuanhao came with a hundred thousand men; that is the customary round number Song writers used for a Xia army, and the troops actually in the line were certainly fewer — some tens of thousands, with the armoured horse as the fighting core. The Song garrison in the fort is recorded as a few thousand men, with Liu Ping and Zhang Kang commanding the foot and horse together, while the relief column was led by Fan Zhongyan and was far larger; Han Qi on reaching Weizhou was said to have a hundred thousand under him, but that is the total of the whole line and not a force massed against Dingchuanzhai. The siege lasted some tens of days and the fort fell around the second month of the second year of Qingli; the Song record says Liu Ping died inside the fort, that Zhang Kang broke out and came back, and that the equipment, the rations and the stores of the fort were all lost. Exact casualties and captures on either side cannot be established and should not be invented. On distances, Dingchuanzhai lay rather more than a hundred li from the seat of Weizhou and some two hundred li from Yuanzhou, and the Song relief marched west from Yanzhou over a distance counted in hundreds of li — that is the geographical scale behind the saying that help could not arrive in time. On the fort itself, Dingchuanzhai was originally a stockade rather than a walled city, and after it fell the court rebuilt it on the same site, the geography of the Song recording it as founded in the Qingli years; from that time the chain of new border forts appears in the geography of the History of Song. For contrast, the figures of the settlement: in the fourth year of Qingli it was recorded that the Song would pay Xia every year silver of twenty-five thousand taels, silk of one hundred and thirty thousand bolts and tea of twenty thousand jin, a total of two hundred and fifty-five thousand bolts of silk, and that markets for border trade were opened at Baoan Army and Zhenrong Army, with Taiyuan Prefecture added later. The weapon on the card is far older still, appearing about 670 in the siege of Constantinople, its formula lost afterwards, and it had nothing to do with this battle.
cause: 打起上來的根由，是西夏要在宋夏邊界上把局面扳回自家手裡。元昊一〇三八年建國之後連年用兵，一〇四〇年在三川口、一〇四一年在好水川連敗宋軍，看似得勢，實際上宋廷在陝西的整軍同時在推進：范仲淹修城築寨、練兵屯田，把守禦從野戰改成以堡寨為骨幹的消耗，雙方都知道再拖下去宋軍會越來越難打。於是元昊要在宋軍新體成形之前試探邊防的虛實，同時用一場足以震動朝議的攻勢，把宋朝逼到談判桌前。近因則是宋方的人事與時機：夏竦去職、韓琦尚未到任，陝西四路統帥之位一度空虛，涇原前線的指揮中斷；而定川寨本身只是尚未築成完整城垣的寨，寨兵為數千，糧秣儲備有限，攻守條件都對夏軍有利。元昊的部署也正對著這個空隙：圍寨與阻援同時進行，使宋廷無法先解圍再反擊。整場衝突本質上仍是兩個政權對關中門戶與沿邊通道的爭奪，只是這一次宋廷手上的牌太薄，守方的時間不夠。
causeEn: The root of the fighting was Western Xia's determination to reverse the situation on the Song-Xia border. After founding his state in 1038 Yuanhao campaigned year after year, defeating the Song at Sanchuankou in 1040 and at Haoshuichuan in 1041, which looked like the tide running his way, while in fact the Song was reorganising Shaanxi at the same time: Fan Zhongyan repaired walls, built forts, trained troops and opened farms, and moved the defence from pitched battle to a form of attrition based on strongholds, and both sides knew that the longer it went on the harder the Song would be to fight. Yuanhao therefore wanted to test the weakness of the frontier before the new Song system had hardened, and at the same time to use an attack violent enough to shake the court into negotiating. The immediate cause lay in Song personnel and timing: Xia Song had been removed and Han Qi had not yet arrived, so the command of the four circuits of Shaanxi was vacant for a time and the command on the Jingyuan front was interrupted; and Dingchuanzhai itself was only a stockade whose walls were not yet complete, with a few thousand men and limited stores, so the conditions of attack and defence both favoured the Xia. Yuanhao's deployment struck exactly at that gap: the fort was besieged and the relief cut off at the same time, so that the court could not relieve the garrison first and counter-attack afterwards. In its substance the conflict remained a struggle between two polities over the gateway of the central plain and the roads along the frontier; only on this occasion the Song had too thin a hand, and the defenders had too little time.
impact: 此役最深遠的影響不在戰場，而在宋朝的政策轉向。定川寨失守加上同年再無勝績，令朝議中的主戰派難以再張；慶曆二年十一月，范仲淹上答手詔條陳十事，正式提出認封元昊為夏國主、歲賜銀絹、劃定邊界、恢復榷場的一整套辦法，把「打」改成「守」再由「守」轉為「和」。宋廷此後在陝西全面改採城寨屯田之策，定川寨在原址築成定川城，沿邊各路堡寨在地理志中成串增列，正是此役之後的產物。制度與人事也隨之轉向：范仲淹次年貶知睦州，陝西軍務由韓琦獨撐，韓琦一面整軍築寨，一面奉命議和，最終在慶曆四年訂下和議。對西夏而言，這一勝換來的是宋朝對其地位的承認、每年二十五萬五千匹的歲賜與榷場貿易，絲路沿邊的商旅重新流動，元昊得以把精力從東征轉向鞏固興慶府與河套牧地。卡面那件兵器在此處還有一層旁證的意義：拜占庭用銅管裡的液態燃燒劑改變對手的移動，東亞在同一時期只有火矢、火把與火障；中國自有石油記載，四十餘年後由沈括在夢溪筆談中記下鄜延出油，但要把液態燃料裝進管子並點上火，還得等火藥與筒式砲具備之後才可能有希臘火那樣的裝置——定川寨的箭幕與火矢，離那一步還遠得很。
impactEn: The deepest effect of this battle lay not on the field but in the turning of Song policy. The loss of Dingchuanzhai, together with the absence of any further success that year, made it hard for the party in court that wanted war to raise its head again; in the eleventh month of the second year of Qingli, Fan Zhongyan presented his Reply to the Imperial Edict with Ten Articles, formally proposing the recognition of Yuanhao as Prince of Xia, an annual payment of silk and silver, a defined boundary and the reopening of the border markets, turning fighting into holding and holding into negotiation. The court afterwards adopted the policy of forts and garrison farms throughout Shaanxi; Dingchuanzhai was rebuilt as a walled town on the old site, and the strings of new border forts that appear in the geography of the Song date from the years after this defeat. Institutions and personnel turned with it: Fan Zhongyan was demoted to govern Mutzhou the following year, the military affairs of Shaanxi fell to Han Qi alone, and Han Qi, at once putting the frontier in order and building forts, was charged with negotiating; the settlement was finally concluded in the fourth year of Qingli. For Western Xia the victory bought the Song's recognition of its standing, an annual payment of two hundred and fifty-five thousand bolts and the border trade, the merchants on the silk road moving again, and Yuanhao was able to turn his energy from conquest in the east to the consolidation of Xingqing and the pastures of Hetao. The weapon on this card carries a further point of comparison: Byzantium changed the movement of its opponent with a liquid burning fluid in a bronze tube, while East Asia in the same period had only fire-arrows, torches and fire barriers; China had its own records of petroleum, and some forty years later Shen Kuo wrote in the Dream Pool Essays of the oil found in the Fuyan and Yan areas, but to load a liquid fuel into a tube and light it required gunpowder and a tube-shaped piece of ordnance, and only then could anything like Greek fire exist — the arrow curtain and the fire-arrows of Dingchuanzhai were a long way from that.
result: 結果是宋軍敗、西夏勝：定川寨陷落，劉平歿於寨中，張亢突圍而還並一度蒙冤，全線宋軍收縮回堡寨線內。此役之後，一〇四三年范仲淹被貶知睦州，韓琦留任陝西主持防務兼備議和；同年十一月范仲淹答手詔條陳十事已為和議定下框架，慶曆四年（一〇四四）宋夏正式訂約：西夏上誓表稱夏國主，宋許歲賜銀二萬五千兩、絹十三萬匹、茶二萬斤，並置保安軍、鎮戎軍等處榷場，邊界大致以宋夏舊界為限。從一〇四四年到嘉祐年間再啟戰端，宋夏維持了近二十年的相安，榷場的商旅與使節往來把斷絕的絲路重新接上，直到宋廷在嘉祐年間再議棄綏州、邊界東移，這一段才告終。定川寨本身並沒有消失在失敗裡：宋廷隨後在原址築起定川城，地理志記為慶曆年間所築，定川城此後成為涇原路的前線支點之一，與鄜延的青澗城、環慶的大順城一同構成宋夏邊境的城寨鏈。回頭看卡面那件希臘火，可以確定的只有一句：它與定川寨無涉，配方在七世紀末已隨拜占庭的沉船失落，此後不曾再現；這一役真正決定勝負的，是寨城是否築成、援軍能否及時、指揮是否連貫，而不是任何一件奇技之器。
resultEn: The outcome was a Song defeat and a Xia victory: Dingchuanzhai fell, Liu Ping died inside it, Zhang Kang broke out and came back and was for a time falsely blamed, and the Song line as a whole contracted back inside the line of forts. After this, Fan Zhongyan was demoted to govern Mutzhou in 1043 while Han Qi stayed in Shaanxi to hold the defence and prepare the negotiations; the Reply to the Imperial Edict with Ten Articles in the eleventh month of that year had already set the frame for the peace, and in the fourth year of Qingli, 1044, the two states concluded their formal settlement: Xia presented a written oath and used the style Prince of Xia, the Song granted an annual payment of silver of twenty-five thousand taels, silk of one hundred and thirty thousand bolts and tea of twenty thousand jin, and markets for border trade were set up at Baoan Army, Zhenrong Army and other posts, while the boundary was in the main the old Song-Xia line. From 1044 until hostilities were renewed in the Jiayou years the two states kept the peace for nearly twenty years, and the merchants and envoys of the border markets joined the severed silk road together again; the episode only ended when the Song court in the Jiayou years proposed giving up Suizhou and the boundary moved eastward. Dingchuanzhai itself did not disappear into the defeat: the court raised a walled town on the old site, the geography recording it as founded in the Qingli years, and Dingchuan city thereafter became one of the forward points of the Jingyuan circuit, standing in a chain of border forts with Qingjian city in Fuyan and Dashun city in Huanqing. Looking back at the Greek fire on the card, only one thing can be said with certainty: it had nothing to do with Dingchuanzhai, and its formula was lost with the Byzantine ship in the late seventh century and never reappeared. What actually decided this battle was whether the stockade had been turned into a walled town, whether help could arrive in time, and whether the command was continuous — and not any piece of marvel-weaponry.
